scanNote: 10-mashqda 'chair / window' juftligi uchun rasmda kreslo derazaning oldida turibdi — 'in front of' ishlatiladi. Shunda ro'yxatdagi beshta predlogning hammasi ishlatiladi ('on' ikki marta). 11-mashqning 5-bandida britancha 'at weekends' olindi; amerikacha variant ('on weekends') izohda ko'rsatilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word(s) in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin yozilgan to'g'ri so'z(lar) tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
EGALIK APOSTROFI ('S) QOIDALARI:

  1) BIRLIK ot → 's
       Daniel's father  — Danielning otasi
       my mother's sister — onamning singlisi

  2) -S bilan tugagan KO'PLIK → faqat '
       the girls' bicycles — qizlarning velosipedlari
       my parents' names   — ota-onamning ismlari

  3) -S siz KO'PLIK → 's
       children's books, men's clothes

  4) IKKI EGA BIRGA (bitta narsa) → oxirgisiga 's
       John and Lisa's car    — Jon va Lizaning (BITTA) mashinasi
       Robyn and Tim's computer
     Har birining ALOHIDA narsasi bo'lsa → ikkalasiga ham:
       John's and Lisa's cars — Jonning va Lizaning mashinalari

MA'NO FARQI — DIQQAT:
  my sister's name  — bitta singlim bor
  my sisters' names — bir necha singlim bor

items.whyUz: Egalik kerak: kimning otasi? → Danielning → DANIEL'S.

BITTA mashina, IKKI ega → faqat OXIRGI ismga 's qo'yiladi.
'John's and Lisa' — ikkinchi ismda 's yo'q, mutlaqo XATO.
Egalik: Tommining mushugi → TOMMY'S.

'girls' — -s bilan tugagan KO'PLIK → faqat APOSTROF: girls'.
'girls's' XATO.
Egalik → STEVEN'S. 'Stevens' — apostrofsiz, bu shunchaki ko'plik/familiya.

Egalik: onamNING singlisi → MOTHER'S.
'My mother sister' XATO.

'name' BIRLIKDA → bitta singil → SISTER'S.
'sisters' name' bo'lsa bir necha singilning BITTA ismi bo'lardi — mantiqsiz.

items.textEn: 8  My ............ names are Nick and Paula.
items.whyUz:
IKKI ism (Nick va Paula) → IKKI ota-ona → KO'PLIK: PARENTS'.
Ko'plik -s bilan tugagani uchun faqat apostrof.

BITTA kompyuter, ikkalasiniki → faqat OXIRGI ismga 's.
'Robyn's and Tim's' bo'lsa har birining ALOHIDA kompyuteri bo'lardi.
Egalik → SEAN'S. 'Sean' /ʃɔːn/ — irlandcha ism, 'Shon' deb o'qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts and the prepositions in the list below to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'zlar va predloglardan foydalanib gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR: on, in, under, next to, in front of

  on ........... ustida (yuzasida tegib turadi)
  in ........... ichida
  under ........ ostida
  next to ...... yonida
  in front of .. oldida

RASMDA MEHMONXONA (living-room) TASVIRLANGAN:
  chapda deraza oldida kreslo
  devorlarda suratlar
  divan yonida kichik qora stol
  katta stol ostida gilam
  stol ustida gullar
  divanda yostiqcha

GAP QOLIPI:
  The + ot + is/are + predlog + the + joy.

DIQQAT: ot ko'plikda bo'lsa ARE:
  The pictureS ARE on the wall.

items.answer: The chair is in front of the window.
items.hintUz: Rasmda kreslo derazaga qaragan holda uning oldida turibdi
items.whyUz:
'in front of' = oldida. Kreslo deraza OLDIDA.
DIQQAT: 'next to the window' (yonida) ham mumkin, lekin unda
ro'yxatdagi 'in front of' predlogi ishlatilmay qolardi.

items.answer: The pictures are on the wall.
items.whyUz:
Devorga osilgan narsa → ON the wall.
'pictures' KO'PLIK → ARE.

items.answer: The small table is next to the sofa.
items.whyUz: 'next to' = yonida. Kichik stol divan yonida turibdi.

items.answer: The rug is under the table.
items.whyUz:
'under' = ostida. Gilam polda, stol ustida turadi.
'a rug' = gilamcha.

items.answer: The flowers are in the room.
items.whyUz:
'in' = ichida. Xona ICHIDA.
'flowers' KO'PLIK → ARE.

items.answer: The cushion is on the sofa.
items.whyUz:
'on' = ustida. Yostiqcha divan ustida.
'a cushion' = kichik yostiqcha (divan uchun).

exercises.explanationUz:
20 ta test savoli — 1-6 unitlarning barcha mavzusi:
  noto'g'ri ko'plik, so'roq so'zlari, predloglar,
  egalik 's, egalik olmoshlari, some/any, chastota ravishlari.

Har bir savolga sabab keltirilgan.

items.textEn: 1  A lot of ............ don't like snakes.
items.whyUz:
'person' ning ko'pligi — PEOPLE (noto'g'ri ot).
'persons' faqat rasmiy hujjatlarda; 'peoples' = XALQLAR (millatlar) — bu yerda xato.
Og'irlik SANALMAYDI → HOW MUCH ('weigh' fe'li bilan doim shu).

Kvartira ICHIDA yashaymiz → IN a flat.
Uy uchun ham: live IN a house.

items.textEn: 4  There are four ............ in the room.
items.whyUz: 'four' → KO'PLIK kerak. woman → WOMEN (noto'g'ri ot).

items.textEn: 5  I always visit my grandparents ............ weekends.
items.uz: Men doim dam olish kunlari bobom-buvimnikiga boraman.
items.whyUz:
BRITANCHA ingliz tilida: AT weekends / AT the weekend.
Enterprise — britancha darslik, shuning uchun AT.
DIQQAT: amerikacha ingliz tilida 'ON weekends' deyiladi.

'you' ega + oddiy fe'l ('like') → DO you like ...?
'Are you like' XATO — 'like' fe'l, sifat emas.

items.uz: Biz doim soat 12 da tushlik qilamiz.
items.whyUz: ANIQ SOAT oldida → AT: at 12 o'clock, at 7.30.

items.textEn: 8  Frank is my ............ brother. He's my uncle.
items.uz: Frenk — otamning akasi. U mening amakim.
items.whyUz:
Egalik: otamNING akasi → FATHER'S brother.
Haqiqatan ham otaning akasi = amaki (uncle).

items.textEn: 9  A: Are these books yours?  B: Yes, they're ............ .
items.uz: Bu kitoblar sizniki mi? — Ha, ular meniki.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'yours' (sizniki) → javobda 'MINE' (meniki).
Javob beruvchi O'ZI haqida gapiradi.

items.textEn: 10  There are a lot of ............ in the park.
items.whyUz: 'a lot of' → KO'PLIK. goose → GEESE (noto'g'ri ot).
HAFTA KUNLARI oldida → ON: on Saturday, on Monday.

items.textEn: 12  There are ............ pillows on the bed.
items.whyUz:
TASDIQ gap + KO'PLIK → SOME.
'any' inkor va savolda; 'a' faqat birlikda.

items.textEn: 13  A: Does Claire work on Sundays?  B: No, she ............ works on Sundays.
items.uz: Kler yakshanba kunlari ishlaydimi? — Yo'q, u hech qachon yakshanba ishlamaydi.
items.whyUz:
Javob 'No' → INKOR ma'no kerak → NEVER (hech qachon).
DIQQAT: 'never' o'zi inkor — 'doesn't never' XATO.

items.textEn: 14  It's raining. Have you got ............ umbrella?
items.whyUz:
'umbrella' UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi → AN.
'some' sanalmaydigan yoki ko'plik uchun.

NARX so'ralmoqda → HOW MUCH is ...?
'How much is it?' = Qancha turadi?

items.textEn: 16  There are some ............ in the field.
items.whyUz:
'some' → KO'PLIK. mouse → MICE (noto'g'ri ot).
'a field' = dala.

'legs' SANALADI → HOW MANY.
Javob: sakkizta (o'rgimchak — hasharot emas, arachnid).
'a spider' = o'rgimchak.

items.uz: Men hech qachon tushdan keyin uxlamayman.
items.whyUz:
IN the morning / IN the afternoon / IN the evening.
ISTISNO: AT night (the yo'q, at bilan).

Ovqat (NARSA) so'ralmoqda → WHAT.
'When' bo'lsa vaqt, 'How' bo'lsa usul so'ralardi.

OT oldida egalik SIFATI kerak → HER car.
'hers' — egalik OLMOSHI, otsiz ishlatiladi: 'This car is hers.'
'she' — ega olmoshi, bu yerda mos emas.

groups.explanationUz: Otning oxiriga qarab apostrof qanday qo'yilishi hal qilinadi.
Sifat OT oldida, olmosh esa OTSIZ ishlatiladi.

items.derived: on the wall / on the sofa
in the room / in a flat
at 12 o'clock, at night, at weekends
in the afternoon, in May, in 2026

patterns.formula: The + ot + is/are + predlog + the + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: The pictures are on the wall. The rug is under the table.
patterns.explanationUz: Ot ko'plikda bo'lsa ARE, birlikda bo'lsa IS.

patterns.exampleEn: Daniel's father, my mother's sister, Sean's desk
patterns.exampleUz: Danielning otasi, onamning singlisi, Shonning stoli
patterns.explanationUz: Egalik apostrofi EGAGA qo'yiladi, narsaga emas.

patterns.formula: Ism1 and Ism2's + ot  (bitta umumiy narsa)
patterns.exampleEn: John and Lisa's car, Robyn and Tim's computer
patterns.exampleUz: Jon va Lizaning mashinasi, Robin va Timning kompyuteri
patterns.explanationUz: Narsa BITTA va umumiy bo'lsa, 's faqat oxirgi ismga.

patterns.exampleEn: There are some pillows on the bed.
patterns.explanationUz: Tasdiq gapda SOME, inkor va savolda ANY.

patterns.formula: egalik sifati + ot   /   fe'l + egalik olmoshi
patterns.exampleEn: This is her car. This car is hers.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu — uning mashinasi. Bu mashina uniki.
patterns.explanationUz: OT bor bo'lsa — her/my/your. OT yo'q bo'lsa — hers/mine/yours.

patterns.formula: ega + never + fe'l (inkor ma'no, 'not' KERAK EMAS)
patterns.explanationUz: 'never' o'zi inkor qiladi — 'doesn't never work' XATO.
